lines: Two beginner gym myths that waste your first year...
and number two eats your whole evening.
beginners need a chest day, arm day split.
Full body or split, studies show about the same growth...
when your weekly sets are the same.
you need two hours in the gym to grow.
Around forty-five minutes of hard sets is enough...
